style: Warm premium coastal New England editorial; soft natural light; cream, navy, sea-glass and coral palette

images.alt: Weathered wooden boardwalk through dune grass at sunrise, with a cream bicycle and a navy-striped tote in its wicker basket overlooking a calm sea.
Sunlit window-seat reading nook with linen pillows, a navy throw, stacked books, an open book and a mug of tea beside a sea-glass bottle and an ocean view.
Sea-glass green yoga mat rolled out on a quiet beach at morning, with a folded towel, navy water bottle and coral yoga block near the dunes.
Artist's table by a sea-view window with a watercolor palette, brushes, a loose seascape painting, an antique compass and coral peonies in a blue-and-white pitcher.
Farm stand table with a colorful bowl of fresh greens, tomatoes and berries beside a crusty sourdough loaf, with crates of local produce and the coast behind.
Friendly cream-and-navy taxi van parked on a seaside village street lined with shingled shops and flower boxes, harbor water in the distance.
Bright remodeled cottage living room and kitchen with shiplap walls, wood beams, a navy island, oak floors and a linen sofa with sea-glass and coral pillows.
Calm, bright clinic waiting room with cream armchairs, a navy accent wall, a wooden magazine rack, plants and a window letting in soft natural light.
Shingled coastal inn porch with white rocking chairs, navy and coral cushions, hanging ferns and blue hydrangeas overlooking the sea.
Vintage sea-glass green and cream food truck with a coral striped awning and string lights, parked by the dunes with bistro tables and the ocean behind.
White gazebo on a village green at dusk, strung with warm lights, with picnic blankets and baskets on the grass and clapboard houses beyond.
Two people's hands shaking over a wooden coffee shop counter, with two lattes and a coral flower in a sea-glass vase.
